Learn to explain how to talk about writing tests that await results and wait for callbacks: Async Test, XCTestExpectation & fulfillment(of:), with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Async Test - A test method marked async, so it can use await directly in XCTest.
XCTestExpectation - An object that stands for something that must happen, such as a callback, before a test can finish.
fulfillment(of:) - An async XCTestCase method that waits for expectations to finish without blocking the thread.

Explain Async Test, XCTestExpectation & fulfillment(of:) in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Async Test, XCTestExpectation, fulfillment(of:) 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Async Test - A test method marked async, so it can use await directly in XCTest.
한국어: Async Test: async로 표시되어 XCTest에서 await를 바로 쓸 수 있는 테스트 메서드

XCTestExpectation - An object that stands for something that must happen, such as a callback, before a test can finish.
한국어: XCTestExpectation: 콜백처럼 테스트가 끝나기 전에 일어나야 하는 일을 나타내는 객체

fulfillment(of:) - An async XCTestCase method that waits for expectations to finish without blocking the thread.
한국어: fulfillment(of:): 스레드를 막지 않고 expectation이 완료되기를 기다리는 XCTestCase의 async 메서드

landscape.hook: Can you explain Async Test, XCTestExpectation and fulfillment(of:) in English?

dialogue.title: My async test never waits

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my test passes, but the callback code never runs before the test ends.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You need an XCTestExpectation. It stands for something that must happen first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So I create the `expectation` and call `fulfill` in the callback?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Then the test waits until the expectation is fulfilled.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I used the old wait method, but Xcode says it is unavailable in my test.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is the test async? Then wait is blocked. Use `fulfillment(of:)` and `await` it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why not just keep the old one?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Because fulfillment(of:) waits without blocking the thread.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nice. Can I skip the expectation if the code already uses `await`?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Then write an async test and just await the result.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So an async test for async code, and an XCTestExpectation for callbacks.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right, and use fulfillment(of:) to wait.
